title: Model Risk Static-Hedging a Constrained Distributionally Robust Optimization approach
summary: We investigate model risk and distributionally robust optimization (DRO) under marginal and martingale constraints. Building on our previous work, we address the previously open case of static hedging with second-period maturity vanilla options and hedging strategies involving a vanilla payoff. We also extend recent sensitivity results to settings where admissible models must satisfy a martingale coupling constraint.
